text:
Went to 4 clinics. The 3rd clinic recommended this place.

Super grateful they were open and super helpful.

Provide medication and a doctor analysis!

Highly recommend stopping by before going to any other clinic!

Really good local clinic.
Friendly, inexpensive, and fast!
The receptionist was very nice; I had a scooter accident, and the doctor was very helpful with a bandage and examined me thoroughly for possible fractures. All this at a good price.

It was a complete failure. The examination was incomplete. I took my child to the doctor, and the examination took less than two seconds. We received medication, but the symptoms haven't improved. I explained that the child had difficulty breathing, a stuffy nose, and noisy breathing, yet they said the child was fine. What kind of nonsense is this? It was a terrible experience, going all the way there for nothing.
author_name: ขนิษฐา สว่างวงษ์

text: The doctor was incredibly friendly, as was the receptionist. He gave my friend an injection in his back and tablets for his severe pain. Within just a few hours, the pain was almost completely gone, and all for a very reasonable price. Definitely recommended if you need a doctor.
